note: Recorded once, from a full-history local clone, the real answer to 'which commit first added this path' for each Experiment Timeline entry. Many deploy platforms (Render confirmed; this is common, not Render-specific) do a shallow `git fetch --depth=1` clone, under which `git log -- <path>` can only see the single fetched commit and wrongly reports it as having introduced every file. Rather than depend on the deploy environment's git history depth, demo/server/timeline.js reads this recorded file instead of querying git live. See REPRODUCIBILITY.md for the full account. Regenerate only if the underlying commit history is genuinely, disclosedly rewritten again — never to make an entry look different.
